links.outcome: LLM accuracy on ophthalmology board-style questions versus human respondents, and hallucination frequency
links.effect: Human accuracy 72.2%; ChatGPT-3.5 58.8%, ChatGPT-4.0 71.6%, Bing Chat 71.2%. Hallucination/nonlogical reasoning: 42.4%, 18.0%, 25.6% respectively.
links.quote: ChatGPT-3.5 had the highest rate of hallucinations and nonlogical reasoning (42.4%), followed by ChatGPT-4.0 (18.0%) and Bing Chat (25.6%).

screen.reason: Evaluates generative LLMs (ChatGPT-3.5, ChatGPT-4.0, Bing Chat) on answering ophthalmology board exam-style questions without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
